Guide: [ComfyUI-RMBG](https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-RMBG)

## Model Links

- [Hugging Face: 1038lab/RMBG-3.0](https://huggingface.co/1038lab/RMBG-3.0) (Official: [briaai/RMBG-3.0](https://huggingface.co/briaai/RMBG-3.0))

**diffusion_models** *(pick one)*

- [RMBG-3.0-fp8.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/1038lab/RMBG-3.0/resolve/main/RMBG-3.0-fp8.safetensors) *(7.57 GB, recommended)*
- [RMBG-3.0-nvfp4.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/1038lab/RMBG-3.0/resolve/main/RMBG-3.0-nvfp4.safetensors) *(5.43 GB, RTX 50 series)*
- [RMBG-3.0-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/1038lab/RMBG-3.0/resolve/main/RMBG-3.0-bf16.safetensors) *(15.14 GB, full BF16)*

**text_encoders** *(pick one)*

- [qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors) *(recommended)*
- [qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors) *(lower VRAM)*

**vae**

- [flux2-vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors)

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── RMBG-3.0-fp8.safetensors   # or nvfp4 / bf16
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors # or fp8_scaled
│   └── 📂 vae/
│       └── flux2-vae.safetensors
```

## Loader & Node Settings

- In **Load CLIP**, set **`type` = `fibo2`**, then connect `MODEL`, `CLIP`, and `VAE` directly to **RMBG-3.0 (RMBG)**.
- Keep **`steps` = `4`** (RMBG-3.0 is distilled for 4 steps).
- Lower **`sensitivity`** to boost semi-transparent foregrounds (wispy hair, fur, glassware, sheer fabrics); enable **`refine_foreground`** to remove edge color fringes and **`unload_model`** to release the diffusion model from VRAM after each run.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and **ComfyUI-RMBG** to the latest version first.

- Node / Workflow issues: [ComfyUI-RMBG/issues](https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-RMBG/issues)

## RMBG-3.0 capabilities and limits

Sources: [briaai/RMBG-3.0](https://huggingface.co/briaai/RMBG-3.0), [1038lab/RMBG-3.0](https://huggingface.co/1038lab/RMBG-3.0), and `AILab_RMBG3` node implementation.

### Resolution

| Item | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| Internal processing area | **~1M pixels (`1024×1024` target area)** |
| Aspect ratio | Arbitrary; auto-snapped to nearest aspect-matched **multiple of 16** |
| Output resolution | Restored to **original input image size** via Lanczos |

### Strengths

- **Fibo 2.0 Diffusion Matting**: Built on BRIA RMBG-3.0 with FLUX.2 VAE (`128` latent channels) and `qwen3vl_4b` (`type = fibo2`).
- **Studio-Grade Soft Transparency**: Captures wispy hair, pet fur, glassware, sheer fabrics, fences, and motion blur with smooth grayscale alpha gradients instead of hard binary cutouts.
- **Cluttered Backgrounds**: Separates subjects cleanly even when foreground and background share similar colors.
- **Native ComfyUI Caching**: Uses standard `Load Diffusion Model`, `Load CLIP`, and `Load VAE`; `unload_model` unloads only the diffusion model while keeping CLIP and VAE cached.

### Limits / notes

- **Strict Loader Requirements**: `Load CLIP` must be set to `type = fibo2` (`46080` text dims), and `Load VAE` must use `flux2-vae.safetensors` (`128` channels) — incompatible loaders will raise a runtime error.
- **Manual Download Only**: Unlike other RMBG nodes, weights do not auto-download (`NVFP4` 5.43 GB for RTX 50 series, `FP8` 7.57 GB recommended, `BF16` 15.14 GB).
- **Semi-Transparent Details**: Lower `sensitivity` (below `1.0`) to boost faint hair or glass transparency; enable `refine_foreground` if edge color fringes appear.
- **VRAM Management**: If VRAM is tight, use `RMBG-3.0-fp8` / `nvfp4` with `qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled`, and enable `unload_model`.

---

## Sampling settings (built-in node defaults)

| Setting | Node Value | Notes |
|---------|------------|-------|
| Steps | `4` *(range: 1–20)* | Distilled for 4-step inference |
| CFG | `1.0` *(fixed)* | Internal flow-matching default |
| Sampler | `euler` *(fixed)* | Built-in `common_ksampler` |
| Scheduler | `simple` *(fixed)* | Built-in `common_ksampler` |
| Denoise | `1.0` *(fixed)* | Full matte generation |

`AILab_RMBG3` runs the distilled 4-step sampling loop internally, so no external `KSampler` node is needed. Increasing `steps` slightly above `4` rarely improves quality and slows execution.
